# Heartland AEA

> Heartland Area Education Agency (AEA) serves central Iowa school districts with special education, professional learning, and educational support services.

Heartland AEA is one of Iowa's area education agencies, operating as a regional educational service center supporting multiple school districts across central Iowa counties including Story, Marshall, Boone, Madison, and Warren. The agency provides comprehensive educational services, professional development, and administrative support to schools and families throughout the region.
